profile.name: Atul Joshi
profile.headline: Curious by Nature. Building by Experiment.
profile.intro: I'm Atul Joshi. Exploring the intersection of business, technology, AI and entrepreneurship. I learn by building, experiment by doing, and document everything along the way.
profile.bio: I’m an aspiring entrepreneur with a background in global B2B sales, sales operations, information management and commercial operations. I’m interested in the practical side of business: understanding a customer, finding a useful solution, and figuring out how to make it work.
profile.currentDescription: PGP in Revenue, AI and Entrepreneurship

story.title: Where I started
story.text: My starting point was understanding the information behind a business: researching industries, organising data and keeping records useful. It taught me to pay attention to the details people rely on to make decisions.

story.title: My professional journey
story.text: At Kingsley Gate Partners, I worked across information management and commercial records. My global B2B sales and sales support experience at Blaze Sales and Services brought me closer to customers, quotations, orders and the coordination that keeps business moving.

story.title: The questions behind the work
story.text: Working across these areas made me curious about the bigger picture. How do businesses find customers? Why does one solution sell while another does not? And how do all the moving parts become a business that can grow?

story.title: Why HiveSchool
story.text: I’m pursuing HiveSchool’s PGP in Revenue, AI and Entrepreneurship to explore those questions more deliberately. I want to connect what I have seen at work with a deeper understanding of revenue, technology and building a business.

story.title: What I’m exploring now
story.text: My interests sit at the intersection of AI, SaaS, go-to-market strategy and product development. I’m also curious about D2C brands, consumer behaviour and financial models. This portfolio is a place to document the work as it develops.

story.title: Where I want to go
story.text: Over time, I want to understand how businesses are built, how they grow and how they generate revenue—and eventually build something of my own. For now, the focus is on learning, trying things and being honest about what I learn.

projects.title: A portfolio that grows with me
projects.description: Turning a static professional profile into a living home for projects, experiments and lessons learned.
projects.problem: A resume can explain where I have worked, but it leaves little room to show the experiments, research and ongoing learning behind that experience.
projects.objective: Create a useful, editable digital portfolio that can grow alongside my professional and entrepreneurial journey.
projects.approach: Start with the story and the visitor experience. Keep verified experience distinct from ideas and learning work, and create a private publishing workflow.
projects.execution: Defined the information architecture, project types and publishing controls. Built the public pages and an admin workspace for content, media and internal challenge imports.
projects.output: This website: a home for professional experience, project case studies and a public learning journal.
projects.results: Implementation in progress. No visitor, business or revenue impact has been measured.
projects.learned: A useful portfolio needs an honest content model as much as a considered visual design. Research, experiments and completed work need different labels.
